_leeme: Catalogo de voces. 'diseñada': crear la voz en ElevenLabs (Voice Design) con la descripcion y pegar su voice_id. 'biblioteca': elegir una voz de la Voice Library que calce con la descripcion y pegar su voice_id. 'nombres_juego': como se llama el personaje en el juego (el cliente reconoce la voz por ese nombre). 'velocidad': cuanto se acelera el audio al convertirlo (1.05 = 5% mas rapido); se puede poner por voz.

akagami.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 24, the natural leader of his group of friends. Confident, energetic mid-range voice, organized and a bit bossy but warm, talks like a team captain and a competitive gamer. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

zent.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 24, dry deadpan humor. Low, flat, slightly nasal voice, speaks slowly and sarcastically as if nothing impresses him, short sentences. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

matric.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 22, talkative and a little nervous, gym guy. Bright, fast, slightly higher voice that rushes when excited, friendly and flirty, says 'bro' and 'hermano' a lot. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

shinbo.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 23, introverted and analytical, likes to explain things like a sociology student. Calm, soft, precise and slightly monotone voice, thoughtful pauses. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

tati.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 22, stylish and cheeky, football lover. Relaxed, playful street-smart voice with a lazy drawl, ends sentences with 'po' and calls everyone 'loco'. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

walita.descripcion: Young man from northern Chile (Iquique and Arica), around 25, a woodcarver. Warm, easygoing, slightly husky voice with a relaxed northern Chilean accent, generous and teasing, says 'vale broder'.

cristonks.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 21, the joker of the group who laughs 'akkakaka'. High-energy, cheerful, slightly raspy voice, quick and mischievous, calls people 'compadre' and 'primo'. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

hasag.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 24, the group's careful accountant who counts every can. Medium-low, steady, slightly worried voice, practical and meticulous, says 'broder' and 'manito'. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

wertres.descripcion: Young Chilean man, around 23, loud and teasing, always making fun of his friends. Brash, punchy, rough-edged voice with lots of attitude, says 'hermanito' and 'wn'. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

meulen.descripcion: Chilean man, around 27, former friend who became a traitor and later a bandit leader. Charismatic, smooth, low voice with a cold undertone; friendly on the surface, menacing underneath. Speaks Chilean Spanish with a natural Santiago accent and Chilean slang.

eduardo.descripcion: Latin American man, around 40, a humble legendary hero who helps everyone. Deep, warm, calm baritone, steady and reassuring even in danger, quiet strength and a little tired, speaks neutral Latin American Spanish.

miguel_angel.descripcion: Young Latin American man, around 19, an over-eager apprentice hero who idolizes his mentor. Bright, enthusiastic, slightly cracking voice that talks fast and gets louder when excited, clumsy and sincere, neutral Latin American Spanish.
